newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian job vacancies fall 0.9 pct in Feb qtr.
newsitem.headline: Australian job vacancies fall 0.9 pct in Feb qtr.

text.p: Australian job vacancies fell a seasonally adjusted 0.9 percent between November and February, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Thursday.
The February fall followed a 7.9 percent rise in the three months to November, which was unrevised.
February job vacancies stood 0.9 percent lower than a year before.
Trend data -- moving averages that iron out statistical bumps -- showed a 1.9 percent rise in vacancies in the quarter and a 4.6 percent rise over the year.
Overtime worked by the average overtime-working employee rose 1.5 percent in the quarter in seasonally adjusted terms but remained 0.6 percent lower than its level of a year before.
Trend overtime for overtime workers fell 0.5 percent in the quarter and was down 0.8 percent on February 1996.
